bio: What is this restaurant's recipe for success? A venue steeped in history (a former printworks), a trio of chefs who worked for Pierre Gagnaire and elegantly crafted market cuisine. Day after day, the regulars flock here, which is always a good sign. Full-bodied flavours and a friendly vibe set the scene at lunchtime for a slap-up meal; in the evening, wine bar and a range of dishes to share....
